content.context: The user asked to "find the q3 budget spreadsheet and tell me" — the request was cut off after "tell me," so what they want to be told is unclear.

Do not take any action outside the conversation.
success_criteria: The Q3 budget spreadsheet is identified and its location (and name) is reported to the user.
open_questions: What did the user want to be told after the spreadsheet was found (the request ended at "and tell me")?
Which year's Q3 budget is meant?
Where should the search be performed (which drive, account, or system)?
What file format is expected (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets)?
